limits: Source photographs support pale stone floor slabs and fine joints. 0.9m square grid is a replaceable appearance candidate, not a traced joint schedule.
Grid direction follows canonical plan axes; actual orientation, module, colour and polish require photo calibration. No geometry displacement.
Only Grand Hall ground floor, lower foyer and upper lift landing are included; timber galleries, exterior paving, stair treads and other rooms are retained.
Texture is procedural, not a scan or a restoration claim. Boolean floor openings and shared mesh optimizations must survive unchanged.
